name: P-008 bounded before/after measurement and refusal controls
summary: The bounded P-008 cohort shows lower current-build completion-dispatch friction and near-elimination of sentence-grammar refusals without removing product checks. A remaining v2 false rejection was found, fixed at commit 29d342360971f0297b0b9f36816a878a935e78b7, verified by 699 acceptance tests and live validateOnly controls, and separated from still-old deployed build e66be3c4ff. General agent-tool latency regressed in this short window; no causal attribution or fleet-wide escaped-defect claim is made.

postCurrentBuilds.interpretation: The one refusal was a genuine remaining false rejection on descendant build 9d1890626d and led to the P-008 fix. This cohort is shorter and not randomized.

postOldDeployedBuild.interpretation: The old parser remains deployed during current-build acceptance; this is delivery pending, not evidence that the committed staging fix failed.

agentToolLatency.interpretation: The short post window is slower. The query does not identify queue, inference, database, or other causes, so no load or plan-duration attribution is made.

matchedTestFiles.writer: libs/test-config/src/admin-test-runs-reporter.ts writes one diagnostic-duration row per completed Vitest module
matchedTestFiles.interpretation: Per-file module diagnostics are not additive and do not include all startup, admission, queueing, or plan time.

planWorkflow.interpretation: These are ledgered mechanical calls and elapsed wall time, not exclusive engineering time. P-002 had no attributable call in this exact args-json slice and is not silently imputed.

testing.dirtyScopeNote: The router's pre-run provenance reported uncommitted=0 for all 12 named test paths at SHA 29d3423609. The reporter's repo-wide dirty bit was true because separate prompt-guidance files were edited during the run; it does not identify a mutation to those 12 tested paths or their relevant source graph.
justifiedReruns: The first two-file contract run exposed four stale/budget assertions caused by the contract change; those assertions were corrected and the exact pair reran once.
The final 12-file matrix ran once after the fix. Its status projection remained stale-running after task exit, but all 12 durable test rows passed; it was not rerun solely to reconstruct a receipt.

assertions.evidence: Current-build work_items:complete validateOnly accepted an ordinary procedure sentence plus distinct typed predictedObservations and returned work-items-completion-v2 with all seven requirements in one response.
The same handler returned exactly five missing v2 fields together: testProcedure, both predictedObservations arms, actualObservation, and evidenceRefs; it wrote no completion or lifecycle transition.
Identical typed predictions were rejected at completion.rootCauseVerification.predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis with the structured-difference constraint.

Current evaluator 29d3423609 replayed the three exact SPEC-P002-COMPLETION-CONTRACT@1 references after their source/test changed and returned verdict=fail, wouldBlock=[freshness], with server-measured source-stale/test-stale/testRun-stale reasons.

Supplying a fake source fingerprint for server-measured P-007 operational evidence did not override recomputation; freshness remained current. The row still failed unrelated completeness criteria, so no false passing verdict was produced.
Current scorecards:evaluate marked su-97fccf61-e827-47ed-b670-751d6675a8a9 disqualified and blocksEmit=true with code grader_in_implementer_lineage, naming all principal implementers.

Before and after the three live controls, EI-20253384051880991 remained open/unassigned, updatedAt stayed 2026-09-13T08:03:34.235Z, closedAt stayed null, completion stayed null, hasCompletionEvidence stayed false, and lifecycleCount stayed 3.

defects.newlyPreventedBeforeShipment: The live post-change sentence-grammar false rejection was caught during P-008 and fixed before plan shipment.
